decisions.reason: Because this packaging-substrate product is very close to the firm's existing glass-processing and interconnect know-how, and it remained on the website into 2024, management would likely keep it and use its strong in-house R&D to refine it rather than exit quickly.

This laser-based through-glass-via offer fits the firm's strategic move toward higher-value semiconductor applications, builds directly on related capabilities, and as a newly launched, prominently presented technology is likely to be retained while the firm learns and scales it.
